tool.name: BIP
tool.description: Barcode Inference Pipeline: from sequencer output to DNA barcodes
tool.command:
## ---- private working directory that BIP.sh will scan ---- mkdir -p bip_workdir && wd="\$(pwd)/bip_workdir" &&
## ---- respect Galaxy's core allocation ---- ## BIP has no "use N cores" flag, only "leave N free", so derive it from GALAXY_SLOTS. cores_total=\$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 1) ; leave=\$(( cores_total - \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} )) ; if [ "\$leave" -lt 0 ] ; then leave=0 ; fi ;
## ---- stage the parameters spreadsheet (BIP requires exactly one *.xlsx) ---- ln -s '$parameters' "\$wd/parameters.xlsx" &&
#if $dictionary ## optional persistent primer dictionary ln -s '$dictionary' "\$wd/dictionary_BIP.tsv" && #end if
## ---- stage the sequencing reads ---- #if $platform_cond.platform == 'illumina_pe' ## Illumina PE: BIP requires EXACTLY two *.fastq.gz and globs them ## alphabetically, so R1 must sort before R2. ln -s '$platform_cond.reads_r1' "\$wd/reads_R1.fastq.gz" && ln -s '$platform_cond.reads_r2' "\$wd/reads_R2.fastq.gz" && #else ## Single-end platforms: one or more *.fastq.gz, concatenated by BIP. #for $i, $r in enumerate($platform_cond.reads) ln -s '$r' "\$wd/reads_${i}.fastq.gz" && #end for #end if
## ---- reference folder for BIP (--refs), holding the BIN index it should search ---- ## BIP looks for <library>.udb next to the SINTAX library and only builds one (a 6 GB, ## ~10 min job) when none is there. It finds the library with "find -type f", which ## skips symlinks, so the image's library is copied; the index itself can be a link. mkdir -p bip_refs && lib=\$(ls /BIP/REFS/BOLDistilled_COI_*_SEQUENCES_sintax.fasta | head -n 1) && cp "\$lib" bip_refs/ && udb="bip_refs/\$(basename "\${lib%.fasta}").udb" && #if $bin_cond.bin_mode == 'index' ## A zip that Galaxy did not unpack starts with "PK"; a vsearch UDB starts with "FBDU". if [ "\$(head -c 4 '$bin_cond.bin_udb')" != "FBDU" ] ; then echo "ERROR: the BIN index is not a vsearch UDB file. If it is BOLD's vsearch.zip, upload it again with auto-decompress on (the default), or upload the unzipped file." >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi && ln -s '$bin_cond.bin_udb' "\$udb" && #else ## No BIN matching: an index holding one placeholder sequence that matches nothing, ## so BIP's search finishes at once and every BIN is NA, instead of BIP building one. printf '>no_bin_matching|NA\nACGTTGCATGTCGCATGATGCATGAGAGTTGACGTACCTAGGCTAATCGGATCCATGCAATGCCTAGCTTAGGCATCGATCGTAGCATCAGTCAGTACGATCGTACGGTCA\n' > placeholder.fasta && micromamba run -n bip vsearch --makeudb_usearch placeholder.fasta --output "\$udb" --quiet && #end if
## ---- run BIP inside its bundled conda env; the project name is the run name ---- micromamba run -n bip bash /BIP/SCRIPTS/BIP.sh --platform '$platform_cond.platform' --minreads '$minreads' --cores_to_leave "\$leave" #if str($advanced.customize) == 'yes' --umi_overlap_min '$advanced.umi_overlap_min' --primer_overlap_min '$advanced.primer_overlap_min' --error_umi1 '$advanced.error_umi1' --error_umi2 '$advanced.error_umi2' --error_primer1 '$advanced.error_primer1' --error_primer2 '$advanced.error_primer2' --minreadssatellite '$advanced.minreadssatellite' --minoverlap '$advanced.minoverlap' --chimera_abskew '$advanced.chimera_abskew' --chimera_mindiv '$advanced.chimera_mindiv' --bin_maxhits '$advanced.bin_maxhits' --bin_maxaccepts '$advanced.bin_maxaccepts' --bin_maxrejects '$advanced.bin_maxrejects' #end if --wd "\$wd" --refs "\$(pwd)/bip_refs" --ref_seq_corr "\$(ls /BIP/REFS/reference_seqs_*.fasta | head -n 1)" '$project_name' < /dev/null &&
## ---- normalise the results dir so the outputs' from_work_dir paths stay fixed ---- mv "\$wd/${project_name}_results" "\$wd/results" && mv "\$wd/results/${project_name}_Report.pdf" "\$wd/results/Report.pdf"

param.name: project_name
param.label: Project name
param.help: Prefix for all outputs. Spaces or '/' are not allowed. Must not start with '.' or '-'.

validator.message: Use only letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-' (no spaces or '/'), and don't start with '.' or '-'.

param.name: parameters
param.label: Parameters spreadsheet (.xlsx)
param.help: The BIP parameters workbook with the 'UMIs and Primers' and 'Dictionary Update' tabs. Exactly one is required.

param.name: platform
param.label: Sequencing platform
param.help: Determines R1/R2 merging (PEAR) and whether chimera screening runs early or late.

param.name: reads
param.label: Reads (one or more FASTQ.gz)
param.help: Non-demultiplexed reads. Multiple files are concatenated.

param.name: reads
param.label: Reads (one or more FASTQ.gz)
param.help: Non-demultiplexed reads. Multiple files are concatenated.

param.name: reads
param.label: Reads (one or more FASTQ.gz)
param.help: Non-demultiplexed reads. Multiple files are concatenated.

param.name: minreads
param.label: Minimum reads per OTU (--minreads)
param.help: OTUs below this per-sample read count are discarded during clustering.

param.name: dictionary
param.label: Existing primer dictionary (dictionary_BIP.tsv, optional)
param.help: A persistent dictionary_BIP.tsv from a previous run. New primer pairs from the spreadsheet's 'Dictionary Update' tab are merged into it.

param.name: bin_mode
param.label: BIN matching (COI-5P only)
param.help: Assigns BOLD BINs to COI-5P barcodes. Needs a BOLD BIN index; choose 'No BIN matching' for other markers or to skip BINs.

param.name: bin_udb
param.label: BOLD BIN index (.udb)
param.help: A vsearch UDB index, e.g. BOLDistilled from BOLD: Upload, then 'Paste/Fetch data' with https://us-sea-1.linodeobjects.com/boldistilled/vsearch.zip (Galaxy unzips it). Your Galaxy may already provide one under Shared Data.

param.name: umi_overlap_min
param.label: UMI overlap minimum (--umi_overlap_min)
param.help: Multiplier on UMI length during demultiplexing. 0.75 for UMIs >=12 nt, 1.0 for shorter.

validator.message: Enter a positive number (decimal or scientific notation).

has_text.text: the BIN index is not a vsearch UDB file

tool.help:
**BIP — Barcode Inference Pipeline**
BIP is a containerized DNA barcoding pipeline for any genetic marker, primer set, and second- or third-generation sequencing platform, with extra features for the COI-5P barcode region. It intakes raw, non-demultiplexed reads plus a parameters spreadsheet and produces per-well OTU tables with taxonomy, target/non-target status, quality metrics, and (COI-5P only) BOLD BIN assignments.
**Inputs**
* *Project name* — required prefix for every output (letters, digits, ``_``, ``.``, ``-``; no spaces or slashes). * *Parameters spreadsheet (.xlsx)* — the BIP workbook (``UMIs and Primers`` + ``Dictionary Update`` tabs). * *Reads* — non-demultiplexed FASTQ.gz. For Illumina paired-end, supply R1 and R2; for Nanopore/PacBio/other, supply one or more single-end FASTQ.gz files (concatenated). * *Primer dictionary* (optional) — a ``dictionary_BIP.tsv`` carried over from a previous run. * *BIN matching* — for COI-5P, a BOLD BIN index (vsearch ``.udb``) to assign BOLD BINs, or *No BIN matching* for other markers or to skip BINs (every BIN is then ``NA``).
**Outputs**
All outputs are named ``<project>_...``.
* *Report (PDF)* — ``<project>_Report.pdf`` summary. * *Publication metrics* — parameters, software versions, and system info. * *Duration log* — per-stage timing. * *Demultiplexed reads (tar.gz)* — per-well reads, useful for SRA submission. * *OTU details* — a collection of per-primer-pair ``__OTUDetails.tsv`` tables.
**Notes**
**Getting a BIN index.** Your Galaxy may provide one under *Shared Data*. Otherwise, use BOLDistilled from BOLD: open *Upload*, choose *Paste/Fetch data*, and paste ``https://us-sea-1.linodeobjects.com/boldistilled/vsearch.zip``. Galaxy downloads it (about 2 GB) and unzips it to the ~6 GB index; keep auto-decompress on, which is the default. Do this once and reuse the dataset. Searching it needs about 7 GB of memory.
The COI BOLDistilled SINTAX reference library (taxonomy) and the error-correction reference set are built into the container image. Set the spreadsheet's ``Reference Library`` to ``BOLDistilled_COI_``; other reference libraries are not yet available through this wrapper.
